name: THE PATRONS
note:
A drinker above the counter top, as his own sprite with his own beat.
THE BANDS TILE. Cutting each man to his own extent left the columns BETWEEN men owned by nobody, and the strip above the counter is drawn ONLY by these sprites -- so a gap between two of them is a hole straight through the bar. Seams at x216 and x409, both inside ranges identical in every pose. The seated man turns his head to look into the room.

sprite.note: A beat, not a loop. 17, 11 and 23 seconds share no factor.
